thread.title: 28 of 30 Dow stocks rise premarket, led by Cisco, DowDuPont

title: 28 of 30 Dow stocks rise premarket, led by Cisco, DowDuPont
text:
Published: Feb 12, 2018 8:09 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
With Dow Jones Industrial Average futures YMH8, +1.09% up 282 points, 28 of the Dow's 30 components were trading higher ahead of the open. Among the biggest gainers, shares of Cisco Systems Inc. CSCO, +1.96% climbed 2.5%, DowDuPont Inc. DWDP, +1.86% rose 2.0% and Walt Disney Co. DIS, +1.72% advanced 1.8%. The two decliners were shares of Travelers Companies Inc. TRV, +1.53% which slipped 0.1%, and United Technologies Corp. UTX, -1.92% which lost less than 0.1%. Among the more active shares, Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.22% gained 1.5% and General Electric Co. GE, +3.39% tacked on 0.7%. Quote References
